## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 0/11 sectors positive; all 11 sector averages were negative on the week, while mixed short- and medium-term stock trends argue against a stronger directional call. Leadership: mixed (3/5 top performers Technology; top five span 3 sectors); style mixed / no clear leadership.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Consumer Discretionary led relatively, though still negative: TJX (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%) RECOVERY; sector return -1.74% for 1W and +3.38% for 1M. Communication (-1.85% 1W) and Industrials (-2.35% 1W) were next-best relative, but neither sector was positive; HON (1W: +1.84% | 1M: +0.69%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Energy was weakest (-7.21% 1W, -14.57% 1M), with MPC (1W: -10.82% | 1M: -21.55%) and VLO (1W: -10.91% | 1M: -21.44%) BELOW TREND. Financials (-4.60% 1W) and Healthcare (-4.29% 1W) also lagged; JPM (1W: -6.37% | 1M: -4.50%) and UNH (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top five: PANW (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%) RECOVERY; INTC (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%) RECOVERY; TJX (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%) RECOVERY; NVDA (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) RECOVERY; TGT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: mixed (3/5 Technology; top five span 3 sectors), with four of five showing divergence rather than confirmed trend strength.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W moves: PANW (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), INTC (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%) and TJX (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%), all RECOVERY. The major-stock divergence is significant: NVDA (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) is also RECOVERY, while several other large stocks have the opposite pattern; watch for trend breaks.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

PANW (1W: +11.81% | 1M: -7.13%), INTC (1W: +7.55% | 1M: -31.39%) and NVDA (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) are RECOVERY; MSFT (1W: -4.74% | 1M: -5.92%), GOOGL (1W: -0.57% | 1M: -11.90%) and META (1W: -4.60% | 1M: -7.01%) are BELOW TREND. Sector stock-level breadth was not supplied; sector breadth was 0/11 positive.

8. Financials Outlook?

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Mixed, with sharp weakness in key names: Healthcare returned -4.29% for 1W and -1.63% for 1M. GILD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) and SYK (1W: +1.75% | 1M: +2.93%) are ABOVE TREND, while UNH (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) and PFE (1W: -5.06% | 1M: -7.43%) are BELOW TREND. Sector stock-level breadth was not supplied; sector breadth was 0/11 positive.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Maintain a selective, risk-aware stance; the data supports no clear style preference, and all 11 sector averages declined on the week. Monitor relative strength in TGT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND and GILD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) ABOVE TREND, while reducing exposure to confirmed weakness such as CRM (1W: -13.67% | 1M: -25.39%) BELOW TREND.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Watch for follow-through in TGT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND and GILD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) ABOVE TREND; the setup weakens if their short-term gains reverse. BEARISH: Monitor UNH (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) and CRM (1W: -13.67% | 1M: -25.39%), both BELOW TREND, for continued downside pressure.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Consumer Discretionary is the relative leader, but remains unconfirmed at -1.74% 1W; watch for broadening beyond TJX (1W: +6.22% | 1M: -3.67%) RECOVERY. BEARISH: Energy is weakest at -7.21% 1W and -14.57% 1M; overall sector breadth remains 0/11 positive.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Price levels were not provided, so monitor return-based triggers: NVDA (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) RECOVERY needs follow-through to confirm a reversal; a renewed weekly decline would reinforce weakness. Watch TGT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND for continued confirmation and UNH (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) BELOW TREND for stabilization.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (+45): won a $197.3 million aircraft order, but BA (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -13.78%) is BELOW TREND, so price action diverges from the favorable headline. CVX (+45): Q3 earnings reportedly tripled on refining margins, while CVX (1W: -4.26% | 1M: -10.86%) is BELOW TREND; the news is not yet confirmed by price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
UNH (-58): Medicare Advantage policy concerns; UNH (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) BELOW TREND, confirming the negative catalyst. CRM (-45): analyst price-target cut; CRM (1W: -13.67% | 1M: -25.39%) BELOW TREND, also confirmed by price action. AMD (-35): share-resale registration headline; AMD (1W: -10.08% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND, with weakness aligned to sentiment.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL regime; breadth is 0/11 sectors positive, leadership is mixed (3/5 top performers Technology; top five span 3 sectors), and style is mixed with no clear leadership. Relative strength is concentrated in TGT (1W: +4.91% | 1M: +10.88%) ABOVE TREND and GILD (1W: +1.80% | 1M: +9.32%) ABOVE TREND. Major trend divergence warrants caution: NVDA (1W: +5.71% | 1M: -21.76%) RECOVERY, while UNH (1W: -18.43% | 1M: -19.62%) BELOW TREND faces a bearish policy catalyst.
